newsitem.title: USA: Starwood Lodging sells hotel for $7.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Starwood Lodging sells hotel for $7.8 mln.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust, a real estate investment trust, and Starwood Lodging Corp, said they have sold the 166-room Bourbon Street Hotel & Casino to Flamingo Street LLC for $7.8 million, including $200,000 of casino equipment.

"The sale of this property is consistent with our strategy of divesting non-strategic hotel properties while focusing on expanding the Trust's portfolio of full-service, high-quality hotels," said Ronald Brown, chief financial officer.
Shares of Starwood Lodging Trust and Starwood Lodging Corp, a hotel management and operating company, are paired.
